versions.title: Things to do in Bergamo: 5 Upper Town sights
Qué ver en Bérgamo: 5 lugares de la Ciudad Alta
Things to do in Morelia: 5 historic centre sights
Qué ver en Morelia: 5 lugares del centro histórico

notes: Four complete ES/EN manuscripts were read by the root editorial reviewer and independently verified by a Codex AI peer. No human or first-hand travel experience is claimed. All nine editorial checks were completed before these exact content-hash approvals.

The 17 cited official sources were actually captured and read, with response status, final URL, UTC date, byte SHA256, concrete facts and short locating excerpts. The basilica operator JPEG and Morelia government PDF were visually read as source documents; they are not served as editorial photographs. Failed and unused research attempts remain recorded.

Bergamo distinguishes the Museo dell’Ottocento closure announced from8September2026 from access to the Rocca tower, ramparts and terrace. Tourist admission to Santa Maria Maggiore is distinguished from worship; conflicting hours, tariffs and age rules are omitted. Lower/UpperTown and the SanVigilio funicular are separate services.

Morelia uses five public-space/exterior stops in two geographic groups. Historical INAH and CultureSecretariat material supports architecture, aqueduct reconstruction, the1984sculpture and place names; it does not establish current festival programmes. Erroneous descriptive blocks and aqueduct length in the government map were excluded. Its itinerary uses flexible urban blocks without inventing multi-day requirements.

Each of ten individually recommended places has its own relevant documentary photo. Specific Flickr author/title/licence pages and the applicable CCdeeds were read. Original source bytes,30responsiveWebPs, dimensions, hashes, bilingual ALT and exact credits are preserved. Contact sheets and the wide Calzada panorama were visually reviewed. No generated or paid images.

Both new city intents are absent from the372previous complete versions. Drafts were checked for originality, factual parity, localized titles/slugs/descriptions and published internal-link targets. Existing articles, dates, images,3Ddesign, advertisements, Analytics consent, disabledpopunder, SEOcode and noonMiami frequency remain untouched. Localpublished is selection for mandatorybuild and is not public success.
independentReviewer: Codex independent AI editorial review; no independent human review claimed

checks.facts: All four complete articles read and concrete historical/place claims compared against 17 retained official source responses and their fact/excerpt records; source SHA-256, HTTP 200 and accessed timestamps checked.
checks.sourceRelevance: Each place and practical section has relevant official place/operator/transport evidence. Historical event stories are used only for durable place facts; failed/candidate URLs are not cited.
checks.imageRights: Ten individual Flickr ImageObject licences, author names, supplied titles and publicly listed exact downloaded renditions read; both CC 2.0 deeds read. Credits, licence links, transformations and BY-SA terms retained. No NC, paid or generated documentary image is used.
checks.imageRelevance: Both five-photo optimized contact sheets viewed with the image viewer; actual subjects match all ten places. MIA notice and Morelia PDF map are research evidence, not served documentary photos.
checks.language: All four complete versions read. ES voseo is consistent; EN reads naturally. Place order, source IDs, history, current access distinctions, practical scope and photo references retain fact parity. Final targeted edits in both Morelia languages and “With more time” in Bergamo EN re-read.
checks.originality: All 372 baseline complete localized versions compared programmatically; no exact repeated body paragraphs. Exhaustive 8-word normalized shingle scan has only incidental generic phrases below 0.11% coverage per new article and no shared 8-word sequence between the two new guides in the same language. Longer source overlaps are 9-word museum names or a short attributed historic phrase, not copied paragraphs; full new prose manually read.
checks.usefulness: Five separately developed two-paragraph places per destination, named locations and context, useful route grouping, arrival/return decisions, access caveats, itinerary, FAQs and relevant onward reading. Length is proportional to the scoped exterior/heritage intent, without imposing an SEO word minimum.
checks.timeSensitiveFacts: Rocca museum closure from 8 September 2026 kept separate from tower/ramparts/terrace and park. Basilica tourist entry kept separate from worship, with conflicting numeric hours/ages excluded. No old concerts, illumination programmes, transport frequencies or prices presented as current.
checks.internalLinks: All six related destination IDs exist published in both languages. Titles and localized slugs are unique in the current catalogue. Browser navigation, rendered SEO and live deployment remain root verification controls.
